title: Sprint workers land clean
goal: A sprint worker starts from the orchestrator's tip in a worktree with the commit hooks and working selfdoc reads, runs the lint the gate runs, ends its processes and leaves no locked worktree; land and sync name the item's code/<id> branch, retry and report an auto-merge that did not fire, re-run after their own rebase changed kbgit.py and refuse another session's commits; flagged choices become gates and a session reads which paths others hold from the backlog.

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
